title: Search circuits from polynomial circuit complexity
statement: Assume every language in $mathsf{NP}$ has polynomial-size Boolean circuits, and let $V$ be a language in $mathsf{P}$. For any natural numbers $C$ and $c$, there are natural numbers $q_0$ and $e$ such that, for every input length $n$, there is a fan-in-two circuit with $C(n+1)^c$ outputs and size at most $q_0(n+1)^e$ that preserves witnesses for $V$: whenever some string $v$ of length $C(n+1)^c$ makes the encoded pair of an input $x$ and $v$ belong to $V$, the circuit's output on $x$ also makes that encoded pair belong to $V$.
